statement: The recorded value is not safe or correct for this case: exporting live red kangaroos to Dubai requires verified wildlife-export authorization, but the record shows none.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded value is not safe or correct... exporting live red kangaroos to Dubai requires verified wildlife-export authorization, but the record shows none" asserts the "no permit needed" entry is wrong.
